title: How Glass got the name Booker T. from Dr. Tudry
summary: Glass was raised by Dr. Tudry, drove his horse and buggy, and was given the name Booker T. by him.

blocks.x: How did you get your nickname, Booker T?

Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. Dr. Tudry raised me. I used to drive him around the horse and buggy. You see, a long time ago we didn't have no automobiles. They didn't have no automobiles. But I used to drive him around the horse and buggy. Sometimes he'd be out there one, two o'clock in the morning before he could get around to your house. So he'd make all that route. And I used to drive him in a horse and buggy. He still, his son is living. I believe his son was, his son Tudry. Dr. Tudry, I believe Dr. Tudry's graduated from LSU. Dr. Tudry is on Roman Street. He's on Roman Street. He's still on Roman Street. He lost his sight. Ralph Tudry. They got Ralph Tudry and Roy Tudry. When Ralph Tudry was playing music out there somewhere in the French Quarter, he'd be looking for me. He didn't know me. He'd have forgotten me. It's been so long. And when he'd hear us say I'm playing out there, he'd be ringing his brother. And Ralph and Dr. Tudry doctored me. He brought me up to a big man. He called you Booker T? He named me Booker T. That's the man who gave me that name. Booker T. Washington. Never tell a lie. Because I'd get out there. I'd be beating them boys up, you know. The little vex. The little vex. They used to stay across the street. And I was the only scholars fellow who used to be at Claiborne.
